lines: Asuka had no memory of being handed “the goods”, and no idea why she was being attacked by cyborgs.
Except for this memory card, which she had just happened to pick up earlier.
She had a feeling that she was being mistaken for someone, both by them, and by that pickup artist.
She was curious about the contents of the memory card, but she didn't want to access an unidentified object like this without precautions.
Moreover, she had a feeling that once she knew the contents of the data, things would get all the more troublesome.
「For now, I'll go back where I was. Hmm, before that―――」
She was still holding the bag with the present for Madam in it.
The bag was a bit wrinkled due to that fracas just now, but the contents were still safe.
She decided to stop by the convenience store in the airport lobby and send it addressed to herself by home delivery service, before any more strange people appeared.
She had accomplished her goal for the day, at any rate.
As long as nothing happened that would, say, blow up the entire airport, her package would probably be safe.
Then, when she returned to the café space from earlier,
There was a girl in the spot where Asuka had been sitting.

She was a sweet-looking girl with chestnut-coloured hair, a white blouse and a checkered skirt, but she had a sword openly hanging from her hip, her ears were a little pointed, and horn-like things were sprouting from her head.
At a glance, she seemed like... a female Hell Knight.
（Cosplay? Or is she the real thing? But, would a demon be hanging around a place like this?）
Perhaps because that girl was waiting for someone, she was looking around restlessly, and checking her watch over and over again.
Asuka approached that suspicious girl, and started talking to her while pointing at the neighbouring chair.
After making a slightly surprised-looking face,
「If you're hitting on me, I'll pass.」
The girl said, with a triumphant face for some reason.
「I'm not trying to pick you up. I just want to sit.」
「I-Is that so? I don't really mind.」
She said, like she was disappointed.
When Asuka sat down next to her, the girl was looking in her direction with a puzzled expression.
And then, she started looking around restlessly again.
This exchange just now was identical to the one that Asuka had had with that pickup artist before.
Could it be that that was a code phrase?
When making a transaction with someone whose face you didn't even know, it was common to identify one another through such casual phrases.
Had Asuka used that by accident?
If so, then that would mean that this girl was that pickup artist's transaction partner, and was supposed to receive the goods.
As if to verify that theory, the girl began to mumble restlessly.
「Strange. This should be the meeting place, though...」
「I wonder why he's not showing up. Considering the time, he should have long since―――Ahh!」
Letting out a loud voice, the girl stood up, and started looking back and forth between her watch and the airport's time display.
「M-My watch is slow? What do I do? Maybe he already came a long time ago, and left because I wasn't here.」

「Ah, I know. I'll call him one more time.
――Oh no, it's no use! I can't get through!」
She began to panic, looking at the clock, trying to make phone calls, standing from her seat and sitting again...
（Looks like there's no mistaking it, huh?）
As Asuka thought, it looked like it had been arranged for this girl to receive the memory card from that man earlier.
And, judging from her glaringly transparent panic, her watch was slow, and she had missed the appointed time.
Asuka was a little hesitant, but she decided to try talking to her one more time.
「Is something wrong? You've been panicking for a little while.」
「N-No, it's nothing. Don't worry about it.」
That was all there was to their exchange, but, perhaps because the girl was worried about being late for her rendezvous, she immediately started talking to Asuka herself.
「S-Say, did anyone show up here before I arrived?」
「Before you arrived? But I came here after you.」
「Oh, I see. That's right, isn't it? Yeah, of course you wouldn't know that. Sorry.」
That was a strangely airheaded response.
「That's right. But because my watch was slow, I didn't make it for the appointed time.」
「Why don't you try contacting them? By phone, or email, or something.」
「I tried to, but I can't get through. I wonder why?」
「Who knows? Still, that's sure a bind.」
The girl was repeating “a bind, a bind”.
In these kinds of transactions, it was common for phone numbers to become unusable after the deal concluded.
Judging from the fact that she didn't even think of that, it really seemed like this girl wasn't a pro.
It would be hard for Asuka to tell her at this point that she had been mistaken for her and received the memory card.
Since those cyborgs had attacked her, the contents were probably no ordinary data.
And this girl was no ordinary person either―――she supposed. It didn't seem like that at all, though.
She had just lightly fished for information, but the girl puffed her chest out proudly.
「Of course it's real. This is the demonic sword, Sakura Blossom. It's a precious sword of mine, that I received from Ingrid-sama.」
An astonishing name had come up out of nowhere.
Ingrid was a top executive at Nomad. A master swordswoman whose name thundered through the criminal underworld.
「Mmm? You don't know? All right, then I'll tell you!」
「Ingrid-sama, you see, is the all-time strongest Hell Knight, and I deeply revere her, so―――」
Just as the girl started to chatter on proudly for some reason, an angry voice rang out.
「How dare you do that to us before!」
It was the cyborgs from earlier. They appeared to have recovered already.
However, this time they were in full combat mode, sticking machine guns out of their shoulders, and readying suitcases that looked to be cannons.
（Do they mean to fire things like that in here?!）
（If they're going that far, then what's on this memory card?!）
The girl was responding to the cyborgs on her own.
「The information dealer's supposed to be a cyborg...... I see! So you guys tricked me to lure me out, did you?!」
「You cowards! You must be pretty brilliant tacticians to trick me. I'll commend you for that, at least!」
One of the cyborgs asked a natural question, but
「Don't waste your breath! Hell Knight Lena will punish you!」
Turning her attention from Asuka to them, the girl―― Hell Knight Lena (Seriously?)――proactively drew her sword.
